note: Bluff park above the Missouri River in SE Nebraska, in hardwood forest. Two RV campgrounds about 450 m apart off the same park road: Ash Grove (51 Electric Plus, 36 Electric) and Hackberry Hollow (32 Electric Plus, 15 Electric), plus tent, basic, Adirondack-shelter and equestrian camping. The river is far below; no site is near the water. --Claude
summary: ReserveAmerica confirms 134 electric RV sites (83 with 50 A), 63 reservable, showers and a dump station, and a modern-camping season of April 15 - October 31 (primitive year-round). The stored 'some full-hookup' claim is contradicted: no site on RA has water or sewer and the NGPC grid gives Indian Cave no Full Hookup column, so water/sewer are cleared. The stored pin is on the entrance/kiosk road junction ~860 m NW of the campgrounds. Not a split: the two campgrounds are ~445 m apart off one park road. Fees left (2026-10-12 grid read).
flags: PIN MOVE (~860 m): stored 40.26484,-95.57980 is at the park-road junction by the entrance kiosk, in open grass. RA GIS for the 63 reservable sites: Hackberry Hollow centroid 40.25906,-95.57207 (the oval loop, sites 001-047), Ash Grove centroid 40.25774,-95.57700 (the row of sites 048-070 to the SW). Suggest the combined centroid 40.2586,-95.5737.

NOT A SPLIT: Ash Grove and Hackberry Hollow centroids are ~445 m apart and both are reached from the same park road (imagery shows the Ash Grove spur leaving the road beside Hackberry Hollow's loop). Under the ~1 km / own-entrance line.

HOOKUPS: water and sewer (derived from the old note's 'some sites are full-hookup') cleared. RA lists 'Full Hookup - no' on every reservable site and no water or sewer hookup on any, and the NGPC grid marks Indian Cave Electric Plus / Electric / Basic with no Full Hookup. Note that NGPC's 'Electric Plus' means '20/30 amp connection with dedicated water hookup or a 50-amp connection', so some 30 A Electric Plus sites may have water; unknown.
PHONE MISSING: the NGPC 2025 rates grid lists Indian Cave SP at 402-883-2575 (RA's page gives no phone). apply.py doesn't write phone.

BOOKING WINDOW wording conflict on RA: the booking-window table says 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival', while the alert text says 'a minimum of three days in advance of arrival' (the grid footnote also says three days). Left to the state:NE row (no cutoff field written).
